summary: Frontend testing of SkyHop iteration 2 (Medals, Themes, Power-Up Feathers, Tab Pause). All new features verified via data-testid selectors. Regression flows (start, live-score, restart, high-score persistence) all pass. Tab Pause + Resume via visibilitychange works deterministically. Medal gating validated at score 0 (no medal element). No console errors during ~30s of play + 15 rapid Space flaps + reload. One benign Canvas2D warning about willReadFrequently.
action_items: Optional: add willReadFrequently: true on canvas.getContext('2d') to silence Canvas2D readback warning (benign, cosmetic).
critical_code_review_comments: SkyHop.jsx is ~991 lines and mixes game loop, rendering, and presentational sub-components. Consider splitting draw helpers (drawBird, drawPipe, drawCloud, drawFeather), themes/medals, and Overlay/Medal/PlayButton components into separate files for maintainability.
Feather spawn probability (0.28 per pipe spawn) is not 'rare' as described; consider lowering or gating by score to match spec if 'rare' is intended UX.

flap() references phase 'paused' branch but Space keyhandler works — good; however clicking anywhere on game-area while paused also triggers resume via onPointerDown -> flap(); confirm this is intentional (spec says Resume button OR Space).
seed_data_creation: None - client-side only; localStorage skyhop_highscore_v1 used for high-score persistence test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 new features (medals gating, themes non-crash, power-up shield-indicator selector existence, tab pause+resume) verified. Iteration 1 mute-toggle z-index fix still holds. Game state lives in refs — only DOM-observable scores are live-score/final-score/high-score and phase overlays. To force pause: Object.defineProperty(document,'hidden',{configurable:true,get:()=>true}); dispatch visibilitychange. Reset hidden to false before clicking resume-button.
